sources.entry: Clipboard Router - Native macOS clipboard manager with searchable history, text transforms, paste queues, reviewed actions, and an encrypted Vault.

summary.one_liner: Clipboard Router is a native macOS clipboard manager with searchable history, text transforms, a Paste Stack queue, reviewed actions, and an encrypted Vault for sensitive clips.
summary.what_it_does: It captures copied text, URLs, RTF, HTML, images, and file references into a searchable history, with filters by content, app, domain, type, date, folder, and tag. Saved clips can be organized into nested folders and tags, and Smart Views store reusable searches. Paste Stack queues clips and copies them back to the system clipboard in order as you paste. Built-in deterministic transforms (trim whitespace, normalize line endings, change case, Markdown quote or code block, JSON formatting, ANSI stripping, URL-decoding) run before pasting. Secret-like clips are flagged for review, and selected content can be encrypted into Vault or shared as Base64 or encrypted for a verified public key.
use_cases: Recover text or links copied earlier
Clean up or reformat text before pasting
Group debugging logs into a Markdown bundle
notable: Paste Stack copies queued clips back to the clipboard in order as you paste
Vault encrypts selected clips behind authentication
Actions are reviewed before external steps run; the app never presses Send
Bundled cr command-line tool for analyze and transform pipelines
Verified ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex routing to signed destination apps
caveats: Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later; on-device Assistant needs macOS 26
Salesforce/HubSpot connectors, hosted Assistant, iCloud sync, and collaborative folders are engineering previews, not available in v0.1.0
Other Mac apps may read plaintext while content is on the shared pasteboard
